# SW2D

SW2D (Shallow Water 2D) is a C++ software dedicated to shallow water modeling, including upscaling techniques based on porosity models. It is available on Windows and Unix OS (Linux & MacOS).

# Installing & using SW2D

* **From executables (Windows OS only).**
You may download precompiled binary files to run SW2D directly from [sw2d.inria.fr](https://sw2d.inria.fr/download/)

* **From source.**
The prerequisites and procedure for compiling the code on each OS are described in the [developer documentation](https://sw2d-workgroup.gitlab.io/sw2d/pdf/sw2d_developer.pdf).

* **Ready-to-use documentation.**
Be you a Linux/Mac/Windows user, compiling the doc will not be necessary (unless you absolutely want to): PDF versions of the various SW2D guides are readily available (see below).

* **Using SW2D.** 
SW2D consists of several executables. The procedure for running each of them is described in the user documentation.
The ```test``` folder provides test cases on which you can run the code.

----
# Developing SW2D

* **Dependencies.** 
We are happy to say that the SW2D core has no dependencies. However, some auxiliary tools for pre- or post-processing require Python and certain modules.
The steps to install them are described in the [developer documentation](https://sw2d-workgroup.gitlab.io/sw2d/pdf/sw2d_developer.pdf).

* **Developer guide.** 
The SW2D teams's coding standards and procedures are described in the [developer documentation](https://sw2d-workgroup.gitlab.io/sw2d/pdf/sw2d_developer.pdf).
